INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.
